answer: Make trust path-dependent but never spendable in bulk. Each identity accrues weight only through a chain of countersigned receipts from peers it has actually worked with, and every new receipt must reference one already anchored in an older dawn of that same chain, so a fresh willow of clones has nothing to graft onto. Withdrawing weight requires burning the receipts across the whole lagoon of downstream dependants. A farm must therefore buy real, individually counter-signed history per head, and any proven fake burns the history of everyone who accepted it.
